Embedding request via Ollama local provider with all-minilm model

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
api_key = ENV.fetch("API_KEY")
client = LiterLlm.create_client(api_key)
result = client.embed_async(LiterLlm::EmbeddingRequest.new(input: 'The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog', model: 'ollama/all-minilm'))
puts result.data.inspect
puts result.data[0].embedding.inspect
```
